payload.claim: The new test only checks that the declared case text appears as a substring of the survived-mutant message (`"the branch where the guard never fires" in by_witness["w1"].message`), never the surrounding wording. Changing the lead-in from `f" (untested case: {case})"` to, say, `f" \u2014 case: {case}"` still quotes the case text verbatim and keeps every assertion in `test_a_surviving_mutant_quotes_its_own_case_and_never_its_edit` green, including the no-case exact-equality check for w3. The suite would not notice the wording of the quoting convention changing, only that the case text itself is present.
